data_fields.name: strike_window
data_fields.donor_constant: 1800 s default (4 s for two sites)

best_idea: Gate every relayed client message on its sender matching the connection, a per-message-type access table (who may send or be addressed), and a strike ledger that counts refused attempts in a window, extends the window on each strike, and escalates to a permanent ban at a count.
decision_why: Take the access table, the sender-equals-connection rule and the strike shape. Key strikes by account or session with IP secondary (the donor is IP-only, which catches shared NAT); keep the broadcast relay out, since Frankendom's server sends state.
acceptance: A client sending a server-only verdict (kill or loot grant) is closed with the world unchanged; a message naming another character is refused with no state change; 100 refused connects in the window from one key add a permanent entry; a single bad-version probe gives a 30-minute refusal and nothing more.
